review: Request: Lin asked for a physically feasible way to open one of two freshly gathered owned hazelnuts (item-11-lin-113) and inspect its contents, keeping any usable kernel separately, without eating it, without assuming tools and without inferring nutrition, toxicity, safety or preparation needs. World Agent decision: develop (learning 1) a general operation open-and-separate-sample(sourceId, quantity, method, toolId?, supportRef?, workId?) for owned discrete enclosed materials, with hand compression and supported tool compression sharing one work and separation mechanism; an opening attempt costs one round and 0.5 energy and reserves one specimen, and a separation round after a real opening costs 0.2 energy; enclosure strength, safe hand force, composition and recoverability must come from implemented material definitions, implemented here when missing, and an unknown response must not default to easy opening or a free kernel; after fracture all material is accounted for as enclosure, recovered contents, attached contents, fragments and residue summing to the input, with fractional accounting, no new nutrition and no decay reset; work record, pause, resume by workId, cancellation and death as specified; only observed appearance is recorded; no eating, safety certificate or reward. Implemented: open-and-separate-sample@1 (scope long-ex20, from a sampleOpeningPackage(id, scope, compositions) factory in long-ex20-sample-opening.ts, registered last in V7_PACKAGES; one study round; the ability serializes to 3,183 code units; sourceId, toolId and supportRef are exact-visible references; no drawing is added, view metadata travels on events and the viewer is unchanged). Modes and costs: open (sourceId, quantity 1, method hand or supported-tool) checks before any charge a living person, an own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated whole unit of a material with a represented composition (hazelnut only), light (the ex19 rule, daylight or indoor light above 0.1) and 0.5 energy, and for supported-tool an own whole, rigid (hardness at least 1), unfractured inedible tool (the ex19 piece and contact checks) and a support that is either a solid, unreserved, visible object in reach of a represented inedible material with hardness at least 1 that is not a plant or an animal, or another such own piece on firm ordinary ground where the person stands; it then opens a work record (workCreate), reserves exactly one unit (workAllocations, workReserve) and pays one round (workPay); open with workId is a new explicit attempt at full cost; separate (workId of opened work, or sourceId of an own opened unit returned by cancel) pays one round and 0.2 energy; cancel takes one round and no energy. Effects: the ex17/ex19 law, load = the weaker surface's strength x (1 - flexibility) with strength = hardness / 10, adds damage (load - strength) / strength only when the load exceeds the unit's strength and keeps it on the unit (processing enclosureOpening): cracked and closed below 1, split open at 1; tools and supports carry no more than their own strength and are not worn; separation replaces the opened unit with an own hazelnut-kernel item of 0.4 and an own hazelnut-shell item of 0.6, both carrying the unit's origin, harvest tick and decay; the ledger records input 1 (mass 0.2), enclosure 0.6, recovered 0.4, attached 0, fragments 0 and residue 0, summing to the input in quantity and mass; the other hazelnut stays an ordinary unit. Events: sample-opening-started, -attempted, -fractured, -opened, -separated, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled and -failed (plus workPay's process-progress, workStop's process-stopped and openRemember's trial-result and information-confirmed), each emitted only at its transition and carrying the work summary and view metadata (operation, workId, source, specimen, stage, method, contact pose, tool and support, enclosure shape, size, colour, texture, fracture state and crack, exposed contents only once open, products and residue only after separation, never a badge); verified personal records hold the observed response per material, method and surfaces and the observed contents with their visibility limits; no strength, load or composition value appears in agent-visible text before it is observed. Lifecycle: every stage commits atomically at the end of its round; a failed recheck of existing work (light, energy, tool or support) records a pause at no charge and the next paid round emits resumed; cancel returns the reserved unit to its owner as it now is (untouched, cracked or opened, never restored) and a later open or separate continues from its recorded damage; death stops the work and leaves the unit where the person fell, neither restored nor separated; a reserved unit that spoils ends the work; nothing is refunded; there is no passive processing or recurring drain. Modeling assumptions: (1) no grip or compression hand force existed on the strength scale, so a bare hand applies hand-break-food@1's bounded bare-hand force (0.1 on its size-scaled scale strength x mass^(2/3)) spread over the unit, a load of 0.1 / mass^(2/3), about 0.29 for a 0.2-mass hazelnut against its strength 0.4, so a bare hand can neither open nor crack a hazelnut and repeated squeezes change nothing; (2) supported compression transmits the weaker of tool and support as in ex17/ex19, without a separate limit on the person's force; (3) crushing of contents is not represented: a controlled compression stops when the enclosure gives; (4) the hazelnut composition is kernel 0.4 and shell 0.6 by mass, the lower bound of commonly reported kernel percentages of about 40-50 %, exact in tenths; (5) a split shell releases its whole kernel by hand (the kernel lies loose in the cavity and its skin counts as kernel), so attached contents, fragments and residue are 0; (6) one unit of either part is one whole unit's mass, so the kernel row has 45 nutrition and 0 toxicity per unit (all of the unit's nutrition and toxicity divided by its share; 0.4 x 45 = 18), eats like a hazelnut (ingredient hazelnut, method unprocessed, quality 0.8, the default meal quality, so no meal variety is gained) and keeps the hazelnut's other properties and decay lifetime, while the shell row has no nutrition or toxicity, keeps the unit's hardness, flexibility, fuel and moisture and, like the world's other inedible materials, does not decay; (7) separated parts age at the ordinary rate, since no faster rate for an exposed kernel is validated; (8) appearance reuses the ex13 hazelnut exterior model (ovoid, 0.035 wide, about 0.05 long, fine ridges) and the ex13 interior colour #d8bd91 and texture, with contents scaled by the cube root of their share, as drawing metadata only; (9) light is required for every paid stage as in ex19. Fractional behaviour in this world: eat, give, drop and pickup take whole units only (integer quantity of at least 1) and a resource reference over several items is refused as ambiguous, so a 0.4 kernel or 0.6 shell item can be neither eaten, handed over nor dropped, and could not be picked up again after a death drop; ordinary decay continues on the kernel; no split creates nutrition (three separated hazelnuts carry exactly 54 in 1.2 kernel units). Lin's case, checked on the archived round-12 world: after one study round a bare-hand squeeze reserved one unit of item-11-lin-113, cost 0.5 energy and left it intact with no crack, separation was refused because only the exterior is visible, a repeat cost another 0.5 with no new finding, and cancel returned the untouched unit; Lin holds no tool, so supported compression is refused before any charge until Lin acquires a blunt tool such as a gathered stone and stands at a rigid support such as a stone outcrop, where one stone press opens a hazelnut. Reuse: ex19 shell-compression-opening@1's law and the shared long-ex19-material-contact helpers (light, firm ground, own piece, contact read on a copy, whole unit) imported unchanged (the ex19 factory was not extended, because its separate refusal and ability text would have to change); ex17 mechanical-food-handling@1's transmission law; foundation-open@1 open.probe's press rule (a material holds a load not above its strength) and object reach rule, without invoking the probe or charging its 0.5 energy and 0.1 sample; ex16 hand-break-food@1's HAND_FORCE; the ex13 exterior and opening appearance models; and the helpers underlying apply-marking-material@1 as in ex20 source revision 2 (openMaterial, openConditions, openRemember, tenths accounting, collectiveFoodProfile and the collective-work escrow and paid-work helpers); ex12 food inspection (a 0.1 portion's exposure fraction) and the ex13 hazelnut packages (bound to specific items, no conserved partition) represent no shell and kernel and were not reused for composition. ex19's five packages and apply-marking-material@1 are byte-identical. No practice milestone (the practice evidence is the unqualified separation event), satisfaction source, pleasure, comfort, nutrition or energy reward is added; the optional 0.1 short-lived pleasure was not added because no installed package uses an ordinary non-protected experience event for informative results. First release: no; the specification is self-consistent and is implemented as a simplified but real mechanism with real costs, state changes and events, and the missing definitions (hand force, composition, recoverability) are implemented and tested here.
